annotations.title: Request or configure a federated binding

description: Without binding, requests (to be accepted) that a production app call a federated connection (OIDC), with a short token signed by while, without a secret; federation must be enabled there. With binding: resume: true resumes a suspended binding; approve_production_deploys, the box for its production deploys.

approve_production_deploys.description: true: its production deploys go through a request; false: they do not.

caller.description: A request: the app's service (web), or "task:<name>".

name: set_connection_binding
